_note: Verbatim corrections to upstream exercise names, keyed by upstream id.
Four records carry `в°` where `°` belongs — a mis-decoded degree sign in the
upstream data, not in ours. Record 1463 spells the same name correctly, so
this is an upstream inconsistency rather than an encoding choice to respect.
Left alone it reaches the screen as 'sled 45в° leg press'.
A table rather than a regex, for the same reason the muscle vocabulary is a
table: a rule broad enough to catch this would be broad enough to silently
rewrite a name nobody checked. The build fails on an id that does not exist,
and on a fix whose `from` no longer matches — so an upstream correction makes
this file fail loudly instead of quietly rewriting the wrong thing.
